timing.selection_information: Integer calendar only, fixed before consequence value or response

reader.information: Six frozen direction/position classes. No current value, expected action, target, token or history is a reader argument.

feedback.scope: Prepared environmental query cadence plus one fixed literal-cost channel independent of action/optimal answer. Does not select A/B credit. A state/response difference is not yet useful policy learning.

timing.phase_selection_information: Exact integer calendar only; no raw sensor value, target, expected response, reader output or memory content.

reader.information: Six frozen direction/position classes. No current value, expected action, target, token or history is a reader argument.

common_use.scope: Prepared fixed scalar sensor plus acquired relative reference in the same world. The host does not compute a comparison or choose an action. Explicit R3P0 calendar, when admitted, is prepared assistance and never learned regulation.
